forum.title: Reading temperature from MKI185V1 using MEMS Studio
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@shmulik\_a,

there is no plan to add this support at the moment.

You can log temperature registers over time by using STEVAL-MKI109V3 serial port communication framework in a PC script. You can find the supported commands in this user manual. [STEVAL-MKI109V3 Professional MEMS Tool motherboard for MEMS adapter boards - User manual](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2116-stevalmki109v3-professional-mems-tool-motherboard-for-mems-adapter-boards-stmicroelectronics.pdf)
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I would like to evaluate  IIS2MDC mounted on MKI185V1 evaluation board using MEMS Studio. in the “Save to File” section I can choose Timestamp, Magnetometer, Magnetometer [LSB}, and Interrupt 1, but not Temperature, although the device has an internal temperature sensor. my setup:

STEVAL-MKI185V1 on STEVAL-MKI109V3, FW: 3.79.1. MEMS Studio ver. 2.4.0 on Windows 11.

Please advise,

Shmulik
forum.author: shmulik_a

scraped_replies.html:
Hi ​@shmulik_a,

IIS2MDC Magnetometer temperature sensor “Log to File” with MEMS Studio is not currently supported.

Temperature register information is available in “Register Map” section.

 

Thanks!
scraped_replies.author: Davide TERZI

scraped_replies.html:
Thank you for your answer.

Any plans to add support for this? Register Map only gives the current reading and cannot be recorded over time, or is it?
